decisionsTitle: «Lista internă (doar notițe)» and «Lista oficială de așteptare», told apart in one read; a line moves to the official list in one press, or is offered a place at once (amending §854, §872)
decisionsSection:
**The owner, 2026-11-01:** «The internal waiting list and the official one, made clear, with a one-press move and an offer at any time.» A staff member must understand the difference in one read, in both languages, on a phone at 320 px: the internal list is notes — nobody is registered or told, nobody holds a place; the official waiting list is the real queue — the person gets emails and is offered a place when their turn comes. On every internal-list line, two one-press actions, the Administrator's alone: «Mută pe lista oficială», the same path as §872, the note following and the line disappearing in the same transaction; and «Oferă-i un loc acum», the same entry and, when no place is free, §642's offer with one supplementary place confirmed in the dialog. The same «Oferă-i un loc acum» as a second button on the official list's add form, and «Trimite-i oferta» reachable and obvious at any time on every waiting row. «Any time» still ends at the start.

**The words.** The two panels on an event's registrations list are «Lista internă (doar notițe)» — «Doar notițe despre cine a cerut un loc…: nu e înscris, nu ocupă loc și nu primește niciun email» — and «Lista oficială de așteptare» — «Coada adevărată: persoana e înscrisă, primește emailuri și i se oferă un loc când îi vine rândul». The event page's queue calls its line «Lista oficială de așteptare (n)» too. Each verb's consequence is in its button and its dialog.

**«Mută pe lista oficială».** `moveReserveEntryToWaitlist`, one transaction: the event row locked, then the line (the order an event's delete takes them in), then the line's person entered exactly as «Adaugă pe lista de așteptare» enters one (`enterOnWaitlistByStaff`, which that form now calls too): the address vouched for (`email_confirmed_by_staff_user_id`), the one allocator under the event lock, the back of the line on a full event or a counted free place, the outcome's ordinary email and no verification email, the emails in the backoffice's language, no public-list tick; then the line's note onto the registration (§777) and the line deleted, audited `event_reserve.moved` with `offerNow` when it was the second verb. Any refusal — the relay tick missing, the same runner already on the address, the line full (§348), the start passed — writes nothing: no registration, no participant, and the line keeps its note. The address is the line's; a line written with none shows a box «Email pentru lista oficială» beside the buttons and is refused naming it when empty. The dialog says the consequence, names the address the emails go to (§875) and **asks for the relay tick itself**: a new `ConfirmSpec.tick` draws the box in the dialog, the confirm button and Enter answer only once it is ticked, and the confirm writes `on` into the form's hidden input (`tickAnswer`) — without JavaScript the input posts empty and the server refuses naming it, so §33's rule stays binding rather than assumed.

**«Oferă-i un loc acum».** The same entry, then — in that same transaction, under the same lock — for a row the allocator left `WAITLISTED`, «Trimite-i oferta» exactly as §642 makes it (`offerPlaceByStaff`): a counted free place, or, on a full event, one supplementary place only when the dialog named the new capacity and the form posted it (`addPlace`, exactly the locked capacity + 1), audited `event.capacity_raised_for_offer` with who and for whom; unconfirmed, `SUPPLEMENTARY_PLACE_UNCONFIRMED` and nothing at all is written, and the page is drawn again so its question asks with the numbers of now. The offer's email says everything, so the waiting-list email the entry queued a moment before is withdrawn in the same transaction, never tried (as §643 withdraws an offer's): the person gets one email. A row the allocator gave a place — nobody waiting and a place free — keeps it: the ordinary outcome is enough. The dialog names the address, then §642's own sentences — the capacity it becomes on a full race, that registration has closed — and its button names the added place («Adaugă un loc și oferă-i locul»). A place free while others wait (automatic offers off) is offered to this person, ahead of the line, as «Trimite-i oferta» may offer it to anyone waiting. The person still accepts and signs their own declaration from the email link. The same second button sits on «Adaugă pe lista de așteptare», on the queue panel and on the registrations list.

**«Trimite-i oferta» at any time, said where it is pressed.** It was on the queue panel's waiting rows and on the registration's page, inside the race-day card; it was not on the registrations list. It is now on the list's «⋮» for every waiting row (`rowVerbsFor`'s `offerPlace`, the Administrator's, before «Dă-i un loc»), with the queue's own question and the sentence «Oricând până la start, și după închiderea înscrierilor…» as its tooltip; on the registration's page it has its own block beside «Dă-i un loc acum», with that sentence beside the button; and the queue panel says it above the line. Before the close and after it, until the start.

**Who.** The Administrator (`canManageRegistrations`), asserted in the action, in `moveReserveEntryToWaitlist`, in `enterOnWaitlistByStaff`, and again by the staff entry and the offer (BR-REQ-060-01). The Organizer keeps the internal list's own three verbs — add, note, delete — and, by the owner's words, only those: the full form's link from a line, its prefill and its carrying of the note (`settleReserveEntry`) are the Administrator's now too (amending §854, which gave «Trece pe lista oficială» to the Organizer and above). The Organizer may still open the staff entry form itself.

**Unchanged, on purpose.** After the start both verbs are refused (`VOUCHED_ENTRY_AFTER_START`): a remote act, so only the desk takes a person then (§637, §872). No overbooking: one allocator, the event lock, a supplementary place only on the press that named it. The declaration is the person's. The address goes through the canonicalizer (the staff entry's duplicate check and the participant's identity). A full waiting line refuses the entry before any offer (§348), for «Oferă-i un loc acum» too.

*Rejected:*
- **A second allocator or a copy of the capacity formula for the move**: both verbs call the add form's service and §642's offer, inside one outer transaction (the inner ones are savepoints).
- **The relay tick on every line, beside the buttons**: a long sentence repeated on every line at 320 px; the dialog asks it once, at the press, and cannot be confirmed without it.
- **Two emails for «Oferă-i un loc acum»** («Ești pe lista de așteptare» and the offer a second later): the waiting-list email is withdrawn unsent in the transaction.
- **Moving silently or offering without a dialog**: §854's refusal of a silent queue and §642's of a silent raise both stand.
- **Bypassing a full waiting line for «Oferă-i un loc acum»**: the line's limit is the allocator's, and the entry joins the line before it is offered.

**Consequences.** `registrations/admin-service.ts` (`enterOnWaitlistByStaff`, `WaitlistEntryByStaffInput`), `registrations/reserve-list.ts` (`moveReserveEntryToWaitlist`, `assertMayMove`, `settleReserveEntry` the Administrator's), `registrations/give-place-tip.ts` (`waitlistOfferQuestion`), `registrations/domain/row-verbs.ts` (`offerPlace`), `admin/registrations/actions.ts` (`moveReserveEntryAction`, `addToWaitlistAction`'s `intent=offer`), `shared/feedback/notice.ts` (`ConfirmSpec.tick`, `tickAnswer`), `shared/feedback/ConfirmDialog.tsx`, `shared/forms/ActionFormIsland.tsx`, `ui/ReserveListPanel.tsx`, `ui/WaitlistAddForm.tsx`, `ui/QueuePanel.tsx`, the registrations list and the registration's page, `admin/registrations/new/page.tsx` (the prefill), `messages/{ro,en}.json`; `AGENTS.md` §10.5 rules 3 and 6, §10.6, §15.11; CLAUDE.md's staff-verbs row. Tests: `integration/registrations/internal-list-move-and-offer.test.ts` (new), `unit/registrations/row-verbs.test.ts`, `unit/shared/action-form-confirm.test.ts`, `unit/shared/confirmed-actions.test.ts`, `e2e/internal-list-move-and-offer.spec.ts` (new). The two-connection race on the last place is `concurrency/capacity.test.ts`, unchanged: the offer's path is §642's, under the same lock. No migration, no dependency, no new message type, no new audit action.
changelogLine: - **«Lista internă (doar notițe)» and «Lista oficială de așteptare»** — the two lists on an event's registrations page say in one read which is notes and which is the real queue; each internal line has «Mută pe lista oficială» and «Oferă-i un loc acum» (the Administrator's, the address vouched for, the note carried, the relay tick in the dialog, one supplementary place only when the dialog names it), the official list's add form has «Oferă-i un loc acum» too, and «Trimite-i oferta» is on every waiting row of the list, any time before the start. §NNN.

specsCriteria.text: Given a line of an event's internal list, when an Administrator presses «Mută pe lista oficială» and ticks the relay confirmation in its dialog, then in one transaction the line's person is entered as «Adaugă pe lista de așteptare» enters one — the address vouched for, the one allocator, the back of the line on a full event or a counted free place, that state's ordinary email and no verification email — the line's note becomes the registration's internal note and the line is deleted; a line without an address takes the one typed for it and is refused naming that box without one; without the tick, after the start (`VOUCHED_ENTRY_AFTER_START`) or on a full line, it is refused and nothing is written, the line keeping its note; an Organizer is refused, and keeps only the line's add, note and delete (2026-11-01, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given an Administrator pressing «Oferă-i un loc acum» on an internal-list line or on «Adaugă pe lista de așteptare», when the entry leaves the row waiting, then in the same transaction it is offered a place as «Trimite-i oferta» offers one — a counted free place, or on a full event one supplementary place only when the dialog named the new capacity (`addPlace`), else `SUPPLEMENTARY_PLACE_UNCONFIRMED` with nothing written — and the person gets one email, the offer, never the waiting-list email besides; when the entry already took a free place, that is the outcome (2026-11-01, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

«Oferă-i un loc acum» adds a place only as «Trimite-i oferta» does: exactly the locked capacity + 1, on the press whose dialog named it, under the event lock, in the transaction whose offer occupies it, audited `event.capacity_raised_for_offer` with who and for whom; a confirmation of another capacity, or none, raises nothing (2026-11-01, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

«Trimite-i oferta» is offered for every waiting registration on the registrations list's row menu, as on the queue panel and the registration's page — the Administrator's, at any moment before the start, after the close too, its dialog the queue's own (2026-11-01, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

batchLine: the internal list (notes) and the official waiting list told apart; one-press «Mută pe lista oficială» and «Oferă-i un loc acum»
